==Overview==
The '''ASL S22 SEASON OPEN Day 2'''  (Korean: [ASL 시즌22] 시즌오픈  ) is an online tournament organized by SOOP.

==Format==
*'''Qualifiers'''
**4 Single-elimination brackets.
**Finals of each bracket advances to the Main Event.
*'''Main Event'''
**Single-elimination bracket.
**Quarterfinals are {{Abbr/Bo1}}. Semifinals and Grand Finals are {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
